notes: Ore rock L: a big asteroid chunk with craters and visible ore veins (copper orange, iron rust, titanium pale, a little crystal cyan). cracked_1 / cracked_2 are the damage stages (turn 0): fissures, then the rock split apart. Break it into chunks with any weapon. Frames are the piece turned [0, 90, 180, 270] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them wrap (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node. `cracked_1` / `cracked_2` = damage stages, `broken` = the burst crate left behind.
